jobs.title: Mandarin and Cantonese Interpreter
jobs.summary: Defrilex is expanding its global network of Mandarin and Cantonese interpreters. Support healthcare providers and patients through accurate, professional, and culturally appropriate language services. No prior professional interpreting experience required.
cardHighlights: Native or near-native fluency in English and Mandarin, or English and Cantonese
Quiet workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and a quality USB headset
No prior professional interpreting experience required
intro: Defrilex is expanding its global network of Mandarin and Cantonese interpreters for upcoming interpretation opportunities.

This is an opportunity to join our growing international interpreter network and support healthcare providers and patients through accurate, professional, and culturally appropriate language services.

No prior professional interpreting experience is required. We welcome qualified candidates from around the world who are fluent in English and Mandarin or Cantonese and are interested in building experience in the interpreting field.
responsibilities: Provide accurate and culturally appropriate interpretation between English and Mandarin or Cantonese.
Facilitate clear communication between healthcare providers and patients during medical appointments and healthcare interactions.
Interpret conversations accurately while maintaining the meaning, tone, and intent of the original communication.
Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, neutrality, and impartiality at all times.
Follow HIPAA requirements and all applicable client-specific guidelines.
Handle sensitive and confidential information responsibly.
Maintain a quiet, professional environment suitable for remote interpretation.
Complete required language proficiency and client qualification assessments.
Follow Defrilex procedures and quality standards for all assigned interpretation opportunities.
minimumRequirements: Native or near-native fluency in English and Mandarin, or English and Cantonese.
Excellent communication, listening, and comprehension skills.
Strong understanding of cultural nuances in both languages.
Ability to communicate clearly and accurately in professional and healthcare-related conversations.
Quiet and professional workspace suitable for remote interpretation.
Reliable high-speed internet connection.
Computer with a quality USB headset and functioning microphone.
Ability to pass required language proficiency and client qualification assessments.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow HIPAA and client-specific requirements.
No prior professional interpreting experience required.
preferredQualifications: Previous experience with VRI (Video Remote Interpretation).
Previous healthcare, customer service, or language-services experience.
jobs.preferredNote: Candidates without these qualifications are still encouraged to apply.
documentsRequired: EF SET English Certificate or equivalent English proficiency assessment.
jobs.documentsNote: Having the optional certifications may strengthen your application but is not required to apply.
workTypeBullets: Flexible schedule based on client demand
jobs.workTypeNote: Opportunities may vary based on client demand, language needs, qualifications, availability, and successful completion of required assessments.
process: Mandarin or Cantonese language proficiency assessment.
Interpreter orientation or training, when applicable.
jobs.processNote: Successful candidates will be added to the Defrilex global interpreter network and may be contacted for future interpretation opportunities based on client demand and availability.
about: Defrilex is building a reliable global network of language professionals to help bridge communication gaps between healthcare providers and patients.

Whether you are an experienced interpreter or new to professional interpreting, if you have strong English and Mandarin or Cantonese language skills and meet the technical and application requirements, we encourage you to apply.
Join the Defrilex global interpreter network and help make healthcare communication more accessible — from anywhere in the world.

seo.description: Remote worldwide interpreter opportunity for fluent English–Mandarin and English–Cantonese speakers. Independent contractor, flexible schedule, no prior interpreting experience required.

jobs.summary: Defrilex is expanding its global network of healthcare document translators working between English and Spanish. Translate member-facing healthcare materials with accuracy, clarity, and cultural appropriateness.

intro: Defrilex is expanding its global network of healthcare document translators for upcoming translation opportunities.

This is an opportunity to join our growing international network of language professionals and support healthcare organizations through accurate, professional, and culturally appropriate written translation.
We welcome qualified candidates from around the world who have strong written fluency in English and Spanish and are interested in healthcare translation work.
responsibilities: Translate healthcare and member-facing documents between English and Spanish.
Preserve the meaning, tone, and intent of the source document in every translation.
Apply plain-language principles so that materials remain clear to patients and members.
Maintain consistent terminology across documents within the same assignment.
Proofread and quality-check your own work before delivery.
Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, neutrality, and impartiality at all times.
Follow HIPAA requirements and all applicable client-specific guidelines.
Handle sensitive and confidential information responsibly.
Meet agreed delivery deadlines for each assignment.
Follow Defrilex procedures and quality standards for all assigned translation opportunities.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow HIPAA and client-specific requirements.
